intro.text: The owner of the Copper Gate, a hotel in New Seran where Wax and his companions stay.

items.text: Gin showed Wax's group to the top-floor suite and grew more and more flustered: Wax tore open windows she had painted shut, Wayne kept trying to trade her for her hat, Steris handed her a list of seventeen disasters that might strike, and MeLaan chatted about picking a body for the party. Gin begged Marasi to get away from these people; Marasi asked her for a list of local graveyard workers and steered her out.

When the group fled New Seran, they left Gin a large sum of cash. As constables' bells sounded in the distance, Steris called back that being "framed for murder" was something her list covered, on page seventeen.

appearance.text: Elderly, with a rather masculine face and an oversized hat covered in flowers.

personality.text: Easily flustered by her guests' antics.
